title: Bathroom Routines

warmUp.question: What do you do in the bathroom?

pages.heading: Wake up
pages.text: I take a shower and use soap.

pages.heading: Brush
pages.text: I brush with my toothbrush and look in the mirror.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What does the child use in the shower?

speakingQuestions.question: Do you use a towel after a shower?

activity.title: Sort the bathroom words
activity.prompt: Drag each word card into a bin. Say the word as you sort.

reviewSentences: I take a shower and dry with a towel.
